title: Persistent mixed worldviews in the theory of chosen preferences
abstract: arXiv:2609.19316v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Bernheim, Braghieri, Mart\'inez-Marquina, and Zuckerman (2021, American Economic Review) develop a theory of chosen preferences and conjecture convergence to pure worldviews at low mindset flexibility. We show that the (original) conjecture fails: with arbitrarily many worldviews, a common-value action sustains mixed worldviews in every stationary equilibrium from a relatively open set of initial worldviews, even when all pure worldviews are absorbing.   However, finite linear programs characterize a sufficient persistence condition. Conversely, mixed accumulation points require shared valuation maxima. If each implementable action has a unique maximizing evaluator, every existing stationary equilibrium converges to purity for all interior flexibility and discount parameters. Experienced utility converges without uniqueness. In existing equilibria, small payoff perturbations preserve compromise over fixed horizons with high probability

translated_title: 选择偏好理论中持续存在的混合世界观
translated_abstract: arXiv:2609.19316v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：Bernheim、Braghieri、Martínez-Marquina 和 Zuckerman（2021，《美国经济评论》）发展了一种选择偏好理论，并猜想当思维灵活性较低时会收敛到纯世界观。我们证明该（原始）猜想不成立：在任意多种世界观的情况下，一个共同价值行动可以从一个相对开放的初始世界观集合出发，在每一个平稳均衡中维持混合世界观，即使所有纯世界观都是吸收性的。然而，有限线性规划刻画了一个持续存在的充分条件。反过来，混合聚点则需要共享的估值最大值。如果每个可实施行动都有一个唯一的最大化评估者，那么所有现存的平稳均衡在所有内部灵活性和贴现参数取值下都会收敛到纯度。体验效用则无需唯一性条件即可收敛。在现存均衡中，小的收益扰动在固定时间范围内以高概率保持妥协状态。
tldr: 本文证明Bernheim等人（2021）选择偏好理论中关于低思维灵活性下必然收敛到纯世界观的猜想不成立——混合世界观可在平稳均衡中持续存在，并通过有限线性规划刻画了持续存在的充分条件以及收敛到纯世界观的条件。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that Bernheim et al.'s (2021) conjecture of convergence to pure worldviews at low mindset flexibility fails—mixed worldviews can persist in stationary equilibria—and characterizes, via finite linear programs, a sufficient condition for persistence as well as conditions ensuring convergence to purity.
